ME034-R1: Official completed-action account of September 13 06:00 reopening, no independent throughput measurement. September 12 report describes planned three-hour Iraqi return permission; such exceptional repatriation is excluded. Other directions and cargo excluded.

ME034-R2: Reported commercial reopening, not passenger or all-border restoration.

ME034-R3: Observation endpoint only; announced September 17 reopening is not verified here.

ME034-R1 duration qualification: The border authority chief said on 16 September that the passenger interruption had not exceeded 24 hours. The one-calendar-day span is therefore not evidence of strict greater-than-24-hour eligibility.

ME034-R2P1: Independent Iranian trade reporting and the Iraqi border authority chief both describe Shalamcheh commercial traffic operating by 16 September. This adds the missing commercial restoration bound without treating the previously announced 14 September schedule as a measured first passage. The scope is commercial traffic into Iraq, not all directions or categories.
